blocks.text: Kapuso actress Mikee Quintos dropped her guard and emotionally reflected on one of the most challenging chapters of her life: the intense online bashing she faced over her college thesis. She spoke during the “Pinoy Big Brother (PBB) Collab 3.0” livestream, wherein she shared how public judgment deeply hurt her mental health. At the time, she was balancing her showbiz career with architecture studies.
